name: songryeon-audit
description: Local Codex black-box logging and evidence-linked self-audit tools.

interface.shortDescription: Local evidence logger; records prompt and tool content after hook trust.
interface.longDescription: SongRyeon Audit records selected Codex lifecycle events and prompt/tool content in a local SQLite database after explicit hook trust, exposes read-only evidence tools, and teaches Codex to reconstruct its behavior without presenting model explanations as runtime facts. Review PRIVACY.md before enabling it.
defaultPrompt: Use SongRyeon logs to explain this action with event IDs and unknowns.
